scope: REQ-0020 (raised 3 times by the WA life of Daniel: d033, d035, d047). Lawful and unlawful non-citizens (ss 5(1), 13, 14); permanent and temporary visas (ss 29, 30); spouse and de facto partner (ss 5F, 5CB); the s 65 decision; bridging visas (ss 37, 72, 73); a visa ceasing when another comes into effect (s 82(2), (2AA), (3)); leaving and re-entering (ss 79, 81(2), 82(5), (6), (8)); allowing a non-citizen to work (ss 245AB, 245AC, 245AG, 486R(5)); work sponsors, nominations and the sponsorship-obligation civil penalty (s 5(1), ss 140E, 140GB, 140H, 140Q). s 235 is repealed (No 1, 2024). Not encoded: the Migration Regulations 1994 (every subclass, criterion, travel period, condition and salary threshold is an INPUT), valid applications, character, cancellation, coercion, referral and aggravated work offences, sponsor sanctions, detention and removal.
